key_findings: Intrathecal aaptamine alleviates CCI-induced thermal hyperalgesia and mechanical allodynia in rats.
CCI upregulates spinal astrocytic VEGF, CD31 and neuronal (including nuclear) LDHA in dorsal horn laminae I-III, all attenuated by aaptamine.
